description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the PackageManager class, including initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling for package download status within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main class managing package download, installation, and notification handling within the plugin.

classes.name: PackageManager::NotificationHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling download status notifications.

methods.name: PackageManager::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the provided service, setting up download, install, and handler interfaces.

methods.name: PackageManager::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters interfaces, and releases connections.

methods.name: PackageManager::Information
methods.description: Returns a string with package manager info; currently empty.

methods.name: PackageManager::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, possibly on a different thread.

methods.name: PackageManager::NotificationHandler::OnAppDownloadStatus
methods.description: Processes download status updates and notifies observers.
